name: lesstif-tools
title: Lesstif Tools
description: Personal Raycast tools. Each module is one or more commands.
author: lesstif

commands.name: switch-audio
commands.title: Switch Audio Device
commands.subtitle: Audio
commands.description: Select an attached audio device and switch output and input together. Devices in use are at the bottom.

preferences.name: hiddenDevices
preferences.title: Hidden Devices
preferences.description: Comma-separated name keywords to hide (example: ZoomAudio, Microsoft Teams, BlackHole)

commands.name: convert-currency
commands.title: Convert Currency
commands.subtitle: Currency
commands.description: Convert amounts written like 1.3M, 100k usd, $100k to krw, or 1억 5천만. Rates from open.er-api.com, cached for a day.

preferences.name: fromCurrency
preferences.title: Default Source Currency
preferences.description: Used when the input has no currency (example: 100k).

preferences.name: toCurrencies
preferences.title: Target Currencies
preferences.description: Comma-separated ISO codes shown when the input has no "to" part.

commands.name: browse-exchange-rates
commands.title: Browse Exchange Rates
commands.subtitle: Currency · KRW
commands.description: Browse USD, EUR, JPY, CNY, and GBP prices in Korean won with daily reference rates and 1-month, 3-month, or 1-year trend charts.

commands.name: convert-timezones
commands.title: Convert Time Zones
commands.subtitle: World Clock
commands.description: Compare linked city times with separate time/date editing and smiling, neutral, or frowning indicators for working, non-working, and sleeping hours. Works offline with daylight-saving support.

preferences.name: workStart
preferences.title: Business Hours Start
preferences.description: Local time in each city, in 24-hour HH:mm format.

preferences.name: workEnd
preferences.title: Business Hours End
preferences.description: Exclusive end time in each city, in HH:mm format (24:00 is allowed). Must be later than the start.

preferences.name: includeWeekends
preferences.title: Include Weekends
preferences.description: Treat Saturday and Sunday as working days too. National holidays are not checked.
preferences.label: Use the same business hours on weekends

commands.name: switch-wifi
commands.title: Switch Wi-Fi
commands.subtitle: Wi-Fi
commands.description: List known Wi-Fi networks in range: 5 GHz first, then strongest signal. Enter connects. The current network is at the bottom.

preferences.name: networks
preferences.title: Networks
preferences.description: Comma-separated SSIDs to compare (example: Home-Room, Home-Living). Empty = the first known networks of this Mac.

preferences.name: maxNetworks
preferences.title: Known Networks to Scan
preferences.description: Used when Networks is empty. Each network is one scan (about 5 s) until Raycast has Location access.

commands.name: search-dictionaries
commands.title: Search Dictionaries
commands.subtitle: Dictionaries
commands.description: Look up an English word or phrase in Cambridge, Oxford, Merriam-Webster, Collins, Dictionary.com, or Naver English Dictionary.
